info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Operational Actions Management API
info.description: The Operational Actions Management API facilitates the execution of various e-branch operational tasks in the banking sector. This API allows for the initiation of specific actions related to channel management, enhancing efficiency and responsiveness in service delivery. Typical consumers of this API include banking application developers and IT teams looking to automate or streamline their operational workflows. With this API, institutions can effectively manage and execute operational strategies tailored to their e-branch environments.

post.description: This endpoint allows the creation of an operational action specifically for the E-Branch, enabling users to efficiently manage and initiate actions related to branch operations.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate specific operational actions within the e-branch operations channel. It contains parameters necessary for the operation, structured in JSON format. Ensure that all required fields are included and adhere to the specified schema.
